releases.notes:
## 🌾 Pocket Estate v1.2.0 - Major Farm GUI Redesign

A complete redesign of the farming system with idle-game mechanics!

### ✨ New Features

- **Full-Screen Farm GUI**: New 7x3 grid layout showing 21 plots at once with pagination
- **Increased Plot Limit**: Now supports up to 180 crop plots!
- **Idle-Game Mechanics**: XP and money rewards for every harvest
- **Plant All Feature**: Select a crop type and plant in all empty plots at once
- **Harvest All Feature**: Harvest all ready crops with one click
- **Bonemeal Storage**: Store bonemeal and boost all growing crops by 25%
  - Left-click to use stored bonemeal
  - Right-click to add bonemeal from your inventory
- **Compost Bin**: Passive bonemeal production over time
- **Auto-Harvest Toggle**: Automatically harvest ready crops
- **Buy Plots Button**: Purchase new plots (Left-click: 1, Right-click: 5)
- **Stats Tracking**: Track harvests, XP earned, and money earned
- **Glow Effects**: Visual indicators for ready crops and available actions

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Fixed**: Removed seed consumption requirement - planting is now FREE as intended for a virtual farm

### 📦 Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
2. Install Fabric API 0.141.1+1.21.11
3. Drop pocketestate-1.2.0.jar into your mods folder

### 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.141.1+1.21.11
- SGUI Library (bundled)

releases.notes:
## Pocket Estate v1.0.0 - Initial Release

A **Vanilla Plus** virtual farming/management mod for Fabric 1.21.11.

### ✨ Features
- 🌾 **Virtual Crop Fields** - Plant and harvest crops without real-world lag
- ⚔️ **Virtual Mob Pens** - Farm mobs safely from your base
- 💰 **Sell Resources** - Convert harvested items to currency via GUI or commands
- 🔗 **Economy Integration** - Works standalone OR with MultiEconomy/EasyEconomy
- 🎨 **Beautiful Vanilla GUI** - Server-side GUI using SGUI library

### 📋 Commands
- `/estate` - Open Estate GUI
- `/estate sell` - Open Sell GUI
- `/estate sellall` - Quick sell all resources
- `/estate balance` - Check balance
- `/estate stats` - View statistics

### 📦 Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.141.1+1.21.11

### 📥 Installation
1. Download `pocketestate-1.0.0.jar`
2. Place in your `mods` folder
3. Run Minecraft with Fabric
